change: Panel second-level pages: a Wi-Fi page slides in over the main page (list, connect with password or enterprise user, disconnect, toggle). No panel control opens system UI any more: the Wi-Fi chevron navigates in-panel; the Bluetooth, hotspot and dark-theme chevrons are removed and those tiles toggle across their full width. Rows come from the WLAN service cache; a WinRT scan refreshes it (30 s limit); WinRT connects. Passwords are wiped after use and never logged.
